label: 8-channel Lite NVR with 8-port PoE
description: 8-channel 4K Lite NVR in a 1U chassis with one HDD bay, one gigabit RJ45 uplink and eight 10/100 PoE camera ports. PoE budget is 72 W total with 25.5 W per port (802.3af/at).
notes: PoE out: 802.3af/at, 25.5 W per port, 72 W total from the datasheet. NVR itself draws under 10 W without a disk. Internal PoE ports are a separate L2 domain with DHCP; camera discovery from the LAN needs the NVR's port mapping or a manual route.

poe.note: Vendor spec table, PoE Port: "8 ports, 10/100 Mbps, IEEE 802.3 af/at"; Power Consumption: "Total output power of PoE is 72 W, the maximum output power of a single port is 25.5 W". 8 x 25.5 W = 204 W of port ceiling against a 72 W supply, so the budget is the limit - five 802.3at cameras at 15 W already reach it. Read 2026-11-20 (200, 514,739 B, server-rendered).
